blocks.text: The search is where it should be at this point: the specification is settled, the company map is agreed, and we are into the approaches. I am opening this thread so that the running record of the {{fact:f:E-2015-001.client}} search sits in one place instead of scattered across separate notes, and I have copied Jeffrey Patterson and James Grant so that nothing waits on my being at my desk. Anything you send back on this thread reaches all three of us, which is the point of it.

There are a couple of things we could use from your side. If your office can hold two half-days for the interview group over the next few weeks, we can build the slate review around them instead of chasing calendars once it is ready. The other is one line in the specification that is still doing more work than it should, the part about ownership of the annual plan, and I would like ten minutes on the phone with you to settle whether that sits with the new chief financial officer or stays where it is today. Whichever way it lands, we want it settled before candidates are sitting in front of you, because it is the first thing a serious finance person asks about.

I have attached the plan we set at kickoff so you can see the sequence we are working to. The first written progress note will reach you in a couple of weeks, and sooner than that if anything changes you would want to know about.
